# Ali's Barber Shop

> Barber shop in Pinellas Park, Florida. Men's haircuts and fades, beard
> line-ups and shaves, kids' and senior haircuts, threading, waxing and facials.
> English and Arabic spoken.

## Location and contact

- Address: 4201 62nd North Unit 9, Pinellas Park, FL 33781, USA
- Phone: 813-895-9229
- Email: alisbarbershop2026@gmail.com
- Website: https://alisbarbershop.com/
- Languages spoken: English, Arabic
- Areas served: Pinellas Park, FL; Lealman, FL; Kenneth City, FL; St. Petersburg, FL

## Hours

- Tuesday: 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM
- Wednesday: 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM
- Thursday: 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM
- Friday: 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM
- Saturday: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM
- Sunday and Monday: Closed

## Services and prices

- Men's Haircut — $30, 30 min (https://alisbarbershop.com/services/mens-haircut-pinellas-park/): A professional men's haircut with clean lines, balanced shape and a polished finish — classic cuts, modern styles and fades.
- Haircut & Beard — $45, 45 min (https://alisbarbershop.com/services/haircut-and-beard-pinellas-park/): A full grooming service combining a sharp haircut with detailed beard shaping, in one 45-minute visit.
- Kids' Haircut (Under 12) — $25, 25 min (https://alisbarbershop.com/services/kids-haircut-pinellas-park/): Fun, clean, stylish haircuts for children under 12, cut at the child's pace by patient barbers.
- Senior Haircut (65+) — $25, 30 min (https://alisbarbershop.com/services/senior-haircut-pinellas-park/): A clean, classic haircut for clients 65 and over, tailored for comfort and easy maintenance — $25.
- Beard Line Up & Shave — $20, 30 min (https://alisbarbershop.com/services/beard-trim-pinellas-park/): A precise beard line-up and smooth shave for a neat, defined, finished look — 30 minutes, $20.
- Full Edge — $20, 20 min (https://alisbarbershop.com/services/line-up-edge-up-pinellas-park/): A detailed edge-up for the hairline, beard line and facial outline — keeps a cut crisp between full appointments.
- Full Face Threading — $10, 20 min (https://alisbarbershop.com/services/face-threading-pinellas-park/): Precise facial hair removal by threading — cheeks, upper lip, chin and forehead — for $10.
- Special Facial — $45, 30 min (https://alisbarbershop.com/services/mens-facial-pinellas-park/): A cleansing, hydrating facial treatment for healthier-looking skin — 30 minutes, $45.

### Add-ons

- Hot Towel — $5: A hot towel that softens the skin before the razor, for a closer shave and far less irritation.
- Eyebrow Threading — $5: Brows shaped and defined with a cotton thread — precise, and gentler on the skin than wax.
- Face Wax — $10: Quick, clean removal of unwanted facial hair, with longer-lasting results than shaving.
- Shampoo — $5: A wash that cleans the hair and refreshes the scalp before or after your cut.

## Frequently asked questions

### How much is a men's haircut at Ali's Barber Shop?
A men's haircut is $30 and takes about 30 minutes, including the consultation, the cut, a line-up and a finish style. A haircut with a beard together is $45, and kids under 12 and clients 65 and over are $25.

### Do you offer skin fades and taper fades?
Yes. Skin fades, taper fades, and low, mid and high fades are all cut as part of a standard $30 men's haircut — they're cutting styles rather than separate services, so there's no upcharge.

### Do you do hot towel shaves?
Yes. A hot towel is a $5 add-on to the $20 Beard Line Up & Shave. The towel softens the skin before the razor, which gives a closer shave with much less irritation.

### Do you offer threading, waxing or facials?
Yes — it's a full grooming shop, not only haircuts. Full face threading is $10, eyebrow threading is $5, face waxing is $10, and a cleansing and hydrating facial is $45 for 30 minutes.

### Do I need an appointment, or do you take walk-ins?
Booking is the reliable way to get the time you want, and you can book online in under a minute. Walk-ins are welcome when there's a gap in the schedule, but during evenings and Saturdays there often isn't one.

### How long does a haircut take?
About 30 minutes for a haircut, 45 for a haircut and beard together, and 20 for a beard trim or a line-up. A detailed skin fade can run a little longer.

### What are your hours?
Tuesday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. The shop is closed Sunday and Monday.

### Where is Ali's Barber Shop located?
4201 62nd North Unit 9, Pinellas Park, FL 33781. It's a short drive from Lealman, Kenneth City and north St. Petersburg.

### Is there parking?
Yes — there's free parking on site, right outside the shop. You won't need to circle the block or pay a meter.

### Do you speak Arabic?
Yes. Our barbers speak both English and Arabic, so you can explain exactly what you want in whichever language you're most comfortable in. أهلاً وسهلاً.

### How far is Ali's Barber Shop from St. Petersburg?
The shop is in Pinellas Park, roughly 15 minutes from downtown St. Petersburg and closer still from the north side of the city. Clients regularly come from Lealman, Kenneth City and north St. Pete.

### Do you cut kids' hair?
Yes. Children under 12 are $25, and the cut goes at the child's pace with breaks if they need them. If your child has had a bad haircut experience before, tell the barber when you arrive.

### What payment methods do you accept?
Cash and major cards are both accepted. You pay at the shop after your cut — booking online doesn't require a card.

### What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
Call or text 813-895-9229 as early as you can and we'll move your appointment. Giving notice frees the slot for someone else, which matters a lot on a busy Saturday.

### I've never been in before. What should I expect?
Arrive a couple of minutes early, and come with an idea of what you want — a photo on your phone is the clearest way to communicate it. The barber will talk through length and shape before starting, so nothing happens that you didn't ask for.
